Information security services

Protect sensitive data and meet regulatory obligations with penetration testing, incident response, access control and blockchain security.

ScrollAbu Dhabi — India

01OverviewCybersecurity

Information Security Services

Information security protects the confidentiality, integrity and availability of your data. Our information security services cover the core disciplines. Penetration testing identifies vulnerabilities in your systems and applications before attackers find them, through VAPT, DAST and SAST. Incident response and forensics give you a fast, structured response when something goes wrong, from containment and threat eviction to digital forensic investigation. Identity and access management (IAM) puts strong access controls in place, with multi-factor authentication and privileged access management for the accounts that matter most.

For organisations using blockchain, we secure transactions and data on blockchain networks. Across all of these, we apply AI-driven security tools for threat detection, so issues are spotted early rather than after damage is done. This service sits within our wider cybersecurity practice. It can feed into an assessment against ISO/IEC 27001 and NIST CSF 2.0, connect to our 24/7 managed SOC for continuous monitoring, and support compliance with regulations such as the UAE Information Assurance Regulation and the UAE PDPL. You get one partner from the first test through to day-to-day operations.

05FAQs3 questions

Information Security Services: common questions

More on Cybersecurity
What is included in incident response and forensics?

We contain the incident, remove the attacker from your environment and investigate how they got in and what they reached. Digital forensics preserves evidence and establishes the timeline. We also support regulatory reporting and recommend fixes so the same route cannot be used again. For ongoing cover, the service links to our 24/7 managed SOC.

Do you secure blockchain applications?

Yes. We help organisations secure transactions and data on blockchain networks. That includes reviewing how keys, access and integrations with your existing systems are protected, because weaknesses often sit around the blockchain rather than within it. Findings are delivered with clear, prioritised remediation steps your developers can act on.

How does IAM reduce our risk?

Many attacks begin with a stolen or misused account. Identity and access management sets clear rules for who can reach which systems, multi-factor authentication makes stolen passwords far less useful, and privileged access management controls the most powerful accounts. Together they limit what an attacker can do even if one credential is compromised.
